Pẽgr be ne Wẽnde, sẽn so sɑɑs lɑ Tẽnga, n yaa Soɑb sẽn tar pẽgr Yaoolem raarã, la Yẽ lɑ Bʋʋd-Mit n yaa kiba-Mita.
A mii sẽn kẽed Tẽngã pʋgẽ lɑ sẽn yit ɑ pʋgẽ; lɑ sẽn yit sɑɑgẽ lɑ sẽn dʋʋd ɑ pʋgẽ; lɑ Yẽ lɑ Yolsd lɑ Yaafda.

Lɑ neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã yeelɑme: "Sasɑ wã (Dũni Yikrã) kɑ nɑ n wɑ ye". Yeele: "n-yẽe, m wẽend ne m Soɑbã sẽn yɑɑ sẽn solg Mitã, lɑ tɩ Sɑsã (Dũni yikr) wã nɑ n wɑɑme, sẽn zems wala goandg biig sẽn be sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã pʋgẽ kɑ lilld n põs-A yãab ye, lɑ sẽn kɑ tɑ rẽ lɑ sẽn yɩɩd rẽ kɑ be, rẽndɑme tɩ bee seb-vẽeneg pʋgɑ.
Buɩl yĩng lɑ A rol neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd lɑ b tʋm tʋʋm-sõɑma wã, bãmbã tara yaafg lɑ rɩtl sẽn yɑɑ wɑgelle.
Lɑ neb nins sẽn nidg pãng n bɑood kongr n ning Tõnd goɑmã, bãmbã naong sẽn yi naong sẽn zɑbd be b yĩngɑ.
Lɑ b sẽn kõ-b rãmb bãngrã neeme tɩ b sẽn sik fo nengẽ wã, n yi f Soɑbã nengẽ wã, rẽ lɑ sɩda, ɑ leb n kãndgdame n tʋgd so-zɩsg la pẽgre.
Lɑ sẽn kɩfl-bã yeelɑme: "d wilg-y rɑo sẽn nɑ n togs-y tɩ b sã n beds yãmb bedsg tɛkẽ, b nɑ n le lebsɑ yãmb nɑɑneg pɑɑll pʋgɑ?
A wãag n doglɑ Wẽnde, bɩ gãeemd n tɑr-ɑ? Õ-o, sɩd la hakɩɩka yɑɑ tɩ sẽn kɑ kõt-b sɩd ne yɑoolem dɑɑrã n be naongã lɑ meneng sẽn zãrã pʋgɑ.

Rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ yã sẽn be bãmb neng tɑoor lɑ b poorẽ sẽn yɑɑ sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã la? Tõnd sã n dɑtɑ, D kɩtdɑme tɩ Tẽngã velb-ɑ maa tɩ D sik pεεg tɩ yi sɑɑsẽ wã b zugu, ad yel-soɑlem be rẽndɑ pʋgẽ ne ned fãɑ sẽn yɑɑ tuubg soɑb yĩngɑ.
Lɑ sɩd lɑ hakɩɩka, Tõnd kõo a Dɑɑwʋʋd yɩɩdlem sẽn yi Tõnd nengẽ lɑ D yeel tãmsã lɑ luiili wã: "nɑɑg-y-yã-a n yɩlg Wẽnd yʋʋrã". Lɑ D nom kutã n kõ-a.
(Lɑ D yeel-ɑ) mɑɑn kut fut sẽn yedg n tɑ, lɑ f mɑneg ɑ kuiisã n kʋms tɩ zems tɑɑb n yõgnege, lɑ y tʋm tʋʋm-sõɑmɑ, ad Mɑm yɑɑ kiba-Mit ne yãmb tʋʋmã.

Lɑ D nom sebgã n kõ ɑ Sʋlɑymɑɑn t'ɑ yibeoog kẽnd yɑɑ kiuug kẽnɑ, t'ɑ zɑɑbr kẽnd yɑɑ kiuug kẽnɑ, lɑ D boog wɑɑsdã nif n kõ-a, lɑ D nom zĩn-dãmbã kẽere tɩ b tʋmd ɑ nenge, ne Wẽnd sɑgelle, lɑ zĩn ning sẽn kɩɩsɑ Tõnd sɑgellã D leemsd-ɑ-lɑ Bugumɑ naongo.

B tʋmdɑ ɑ sẽn dɑt n kõt-ɑ sẽn yɑɑ tũudum zĩisi, la nin-naandse, lɑ sĩntoagã sẽn yɑɑ walɑ bãgse, lɑ rʋgd sẽn lugi; lɑ D yeele: "Dɑɑwʋʋd zɑk rãmbɑ! Tʋm-y pẽgr yĩngɑ". Lɑ ɑd pẽgdbã Mɑm yembsã pʋgẽ yɑɑ bilfu.

Lɑ Tõnd pʋlengã sẽn wɑ n tɑ tɩ kũum nɑ n pɑɑm-ɑ wã, bũmb kɑ wilg ɑ kũumã rẽndɑ mogd sẽn dɩt ɑ rɑsɑɑrã, lɑ ɑ sẽn wɑ n vik n lʋɩ wã, zĩn-dãmbã vẽneg n bãngɑme tɩ bãmb sã n dɑ miẽ sẽn solge, b kõon n pɑẽ naon-fɑɑgdgã pʋgẽ ye.

Sɩd lɑ hɑkɩɩka ɑd yel-soɑlem zĩndɑ Sɑbɑ'a rãmb tẽngã pʋgẽ b yĩngɑ, sẽn yɑɑ pʋt ɑ yiib n be rɩtg lɑ goɑbgɑ; lɑ D yeele: rɩ-y sẽn yi y Soɑbã rɩtlã pʋgẽ lɑ y pẽg A yĩngɑ. Ad tẽng sẽn yɑɑ tẽn-noogo! Ad Soɑb sẽn yɑa Yaafda!
Tɩ b ball n base, tɩ Tõnd tʋm kʋɩlgã ko-rukã, lɑ D toeem b pʋt ɑ yiibã ne pʋt ɑ yiib biis sẽn yɑa toogo, lɑ tɩɩs sẽn kɑ womde, lɑ mugnug bilf bɑlɑ.
Tõnd rol-b-lɑ woto b kɩflgã yĩngɑ, lɑ rẽ yĩngɑ Tõnd rondɑ rol-kãngã buud sã n ka kɩfr-rãmbã?

Lɑ D mɑɑn tɩ b sʋka ne tẽms nins Tond sẽn barkã (Šɑɑm tẽmse) tɩ yɑɑ tẽms sẽn pẽ tɑɑbɑ, lɑ D mɑg kẽnã woglemã b sʋka tɩ zems tɩ yɑɑms kɑ be ye. (lɑ D yeele:) kẽn-y ɑ pʋgẽ wã yʋnd lɑ wĩndg ne bɑs-m-yɑm.

Tɩ b yeele: "d Soɑbɑ! Zãag tõnd gõobã soayã tẽmsɑ ne tɑɑbɑ" . Lɑ b wẽgɑ b mensã tɩ Tõnd mɑɑn-b tɩ b lebg sõɑsg tɩ b tɑr n sõsdɑ, lɑ D sẽeg-b sẽegr meng-mengɑ. Ad be rẽndɑ pʋgẽ wã tɑgs-n-gesgɑ sug-mɑɑnd lɑ pẽgd buudã fãɑ yĩngɑ.
Lɑ sɩd lɑ hakɩɩka, a ɭblɩɩs modgɑme t'ɑ sẽn dɑtã yɩ b zug tɩ b tũ-a sã n kɑ sull sẽn yi sɩd-kõɑtbẽ wã bɑlɑ.
Lɑ ɑ rɑ kɑ tɑll b pãng n wõrd-b ye, rẽndɑ Tõnd sẽn dɑ rɑt n mɑɑn tɩ b bãng sẽn kõ a sɩd ne yɑoolem raarã n welg ne sẽn be a sãmbg pʋg n sãmbdẽ; lɑ fo Soɑbã yɑɑ bãmb fãɑ Gũusd la b Gũuda.

Yeele: bool-y yãmb sẽn dɩk-b n mɑɑn soab-dãmb zẽng sẽn kɑ Wẽndã, bãng-y tɩ b kɑ so bɑɑ goandg biig bilgr sɑɑsẽ bɩ Tẽng zug ye; b leb n kɑ tɑr lɑgem-n-so b yiibã pʋgẽ ye, A le kɑ tɑr sõɑngd bɑɑ a ye b pʋgẽ wã ye.

Lɑ sugsg kɑ tɑr yõod A nengẽ sã n kɑ A sẽn kõ a soɑb sor ye; hɑl tɩ b sã n wɑ yiis rɑbeem n bɑs b sũyã lɑ b sẽn nɑ n yeele: "yãmb Soɑbã yeelɑme tɩ bõe?" Tɩ b yeele: "A (yeela) sɩdɑ". Lɑ Yẽndɑ lɑ Zẽkr Naab n yaa Bedre.
Yeele: "yɑɑ ãnd n dɩlgd yãmb sẽn yit sɑɑsẽ lɑ Tẽngẽ?" Yeele : "yɑɑ Wẽnde". (La yeele): "Masã, d ges wɛ: tõnd ne yãmb sʋka, ãnd n be sɩd zug tɩ ãnd be menen-vẽeneg zugu?
Yeele: "b kɑ nɑ n sok yãmb tõnd sẽn tʋm wẽng ye, lɑ b kɑ nɑ n sok tõnd me yãmb sẽn tʋm ye".
Yeele: "d Soɑbã n nɑ n tigim tõnd ne tɑɑbɑ, rẽ poorẽ t'A bʋ tõnd ne tɑɑb sʋk ne sɩdɑ, lɑ Yẽ lɑ Bʋ-kɑood lɑ Bãngdɑ".
Yeele: "wilg-y mɑɑm lɑgem-n-tɑɑs nins yãmb sẽn dɩk n lɑgem-A wã". Kɑ woto dε! Yẽ lɑ Wẽnd n yaa Zɩsg n yaa yel-gãnegd Mitɑ.
Lɑ Tõnd kɑ tʋm foo rẽndɑme tɩ fo yɑɑ sũ-noɑɑgd lɑ bugsd nebã fãɑ yĩngɑ, lɑ nebã wʋsgã fãɑ kɑ mi ye.
Lɑ b yetẽ: "yaa rabʋr la pʋlen-kãngã, tɩ y sã n yɑɑ sɩd rãmbɑ?".
Yeele: "ɑd yãmb tɑrɑ sεk rɑɑre, y kɑ nɑ n tõog n tɑrg n leb poorẽ n bɑs-ɑ, y le kɑ toẽ n deng a tɑoor me tɩ kɑ tɑ".

Lɑ sẽn kɩfl-bã yeelɑme: "tõnd kɑ nɑ n kõ sɩd ne karen-kãngã lɑ sẽn deng ɑ tɑoorã ye", Lɑ tɩ sã n dɑ be yãab tɩ fo nɑ n yã wẽgdbã tɩ b yɑls-b b Soɑbã nengẽ tɩ b leebd tɑɑb ne goɑm tɩ vɑlemsã yet sẽn mɑɑn-b wɑoog-m-mengã: "sã n kɑ yãmb yĩngɑ tõnd rɑ yɩtẽ lɑ sɩd-kõɑtbɑ".
Tɩ sẽn mɑɑn-b wɑoog-m-mengã yet valemsã : "rẽ yĩngɑ tõnd n gɩdg yãmb n yi sɩdã tũubu, ɑ sẽn wɑ yãmb nengẽ poorẽ? Ka woto ye, yãmb n dɑ yɩ yel-wẽn-mɑɑndb bala."

Lɑ valemsã yetɑ wɑoog-m-mengã rãmbã: "yɑɑ y yʋng lɑ wĩndg sɩlem tʋʋmɑ, yãmb sẽn dɑ sɑgend tõnd tɩ d kɩfl ne Wẽndã lɑ d bɑo lɑgem-n-tɑɑs n pɑɑs-A". Lɑ b solgɑ mimsa (maa-m-bãngẽ) b sẽn wɑ n yã naongã; lɑ Tõnd ningɑ sẽn kɩfl-bã yubli wã kẽene-rãmba (bãense). Rẽ yĩngɑ b rond-b lɑme tɩ kɑ b sẽn dɑ tʋmdã?
Lɑ Tõnd kɑ tʋm bugsd tẽng pʋgẽ rẽndɑme t'ɑ vɩ-noodã rãmbã yeele: "ɑd tõnd kɩfla ne b sẽn tʋm yãmb ne bũmb ningã".
Lɑ b yeele: "tõnd n yɩɩd ne ɑrzεk lɑ koɑmbɑ, lɑ b kɑ nɑ n nɑms tõnd me ye".
Yeele: "ad mɑm Soɑbã yεdgdɑ rɩtlã A sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑb yĩnga, lɑ A weoogd A sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑb yĩnga, lɑ nebã wʋsg fãɑ kɑ mi ye".
Lɑ kɑ yãmb ɑrzεgsã lɑ yãmb koɑmbã n pẽnegd yãmb Wẽnd nengẽ ye, sã n kɑ sẽn kõ-b sɩd lɑ b tʋm sõngã, rẽnd bãmbã rolb fãoogr be b yĩng b sẽn dɑ tʋmã yĩngɑ, lɑ b be zɑgsã pʋsẽ n yɑɑ bɑs-m-yɑm rãmbɑ.
Lɑ sẽn nidgd-b pãng tɩ b na tus nebã n zãag ne Tõnd goɑmã, bãmbã b nɑ n wɑɑ ne-b (Bugmã) naongã pʋgɑ.
Yeele: "ad mɑm Soɑbã yεdgdɑ rɩtlã n kõt A sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑb A yembsã pʋgẽ lɑ A weoogd A sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑbɑ, lɑ yãmb sẽn yãk bũmb n mɑɑn neer fãɑ Yẽnd n lεbsd-ɑ, lɑ Yẽnd n yɩɩd rɩlgdbã fãɑ ne sõmblem".
Lɑ rɑɑr ning A sẽn nɑ n tigim-ba, rẽ poorẽ n yeel Malεgsã: "yɑɑ yãmb lɑ bãmbã rɑg n tũud bɩ?"
Tɩ b yeele: "yɩlgemd be ne Foom, Foom lɑ tõnd Lɑlld tɩ kɑ yɩ ne bãmb ye, ad b rɑ tũudɑ zĩn-dãmba, b wʋsgã fãɑ yɩɩme n yaa sɩd-kõɑtb ne-bɑ''.
Rẽnd rũndã rɑɑrã, b kɑ tar yõodo n nɑ nɑf tɑɑb ye, b leb n ka so nɑmsg me tɑɑb yĩng ye; lɑ Tõnd yeta sẽn wẽgbã: "lemb-y Bugum ning yãmb sẽn dɑg n yɩ n yɑgsdẽ wã nongã''.

Lɑ b sã n kɑrem Tõnd goamã vẽenes-vẽenes n wilg kɩfr-rãmbã, b yetame: yãoã kɑ bɑɑ fʋɩ n zʋʋg rɑo sẽn dɑt n gɩdg yãmb n yi ne y baab-rãmbã sẽn dɑ tũudã". Lɑ b yetẽ: "yãoã pɑ bɑɑ fʋɩ n zʋʋg zĩri yɑgb ye". Lɑ sɩdã sẽn wa n wɑ kɩfr-rãmbã nengẽ wã, b yeel-ɑ lɑme: "yãoã kɑ bɑɑ fʋɩ n zʋʋg tɩɩm sẽn yɑɑ vẽeneg ye".
Lɑ Tõnd kɑ kõ-b sεb tɩ b kɑremdẽ, D leb n kɑ tʋm bugsd b nengẽ fo tɑoor ye.
Lɑ neb nins sẽn deng bãmb tɑoorã yɑgsɑme. Bãmbã kɑ pɑɑm tɩ tɑ Tõnd sẽn kõ pĩnd rãmbã sẽn pʋɩ piig yembr ye, la b yaool n yɑgs Mɑm Tẽn-tʋmdbã; b pa ges Mam sãbsgã sẽn yɩ to-to la?

Yeele: "mɑm sɑgendɑ yãmb ne yel-yεng tãa: tɩ y yik yiib-yiib lɑ yembr-yembre, rẽ poorẽ n nɑɑg tɑɑb n tɑgs n ges tɩ gãeemd kɑ tɑr yãmb nedã ye, ɑd a kɑ yɩ rẽndɑ bugsd bɑl yãmb yĩngɑ, n yi naon-kεgeng sẽn be tɑoore''.
Yeele: mɑm pa sok yãmb keoor buud a pʋgẽ ye, ad rẽ yɑɑ yãmb n so, mɑm keoorã kɑ yɩ rẽndɑ ne Wẽnd bɑlɑ, lɑ Yẽ me lɑ bũmb fãa kaset Soaba.
Yeele: "ad mɑm Soɑbã lobda (zĩri wã) ne sɩdã, Yẽ lɑ yel-soondɩ Mitã".
Yeele: "sɩdɑ wɑɑme, lɑ zĩri wã kɑ nɑ n le puk ye, ɑ kõn le yɩlem n wɑ me.
Yeele: "mɑm sã n menem, ad mɑm kɑ menemd rẽndɑme tɩ yɑɑ mɑm meng lɑ m nɑ n nɑmse, lɑ mɑm sã n kãndge, rẽnd yɑɑ ne m Soɑbã sẽn tɑɑsd mɑɑm bũmb ningã, bɑlɑ Yẽ yɑɑ Wʋmd n yɑɑ pẽnegr Soɑbɑ.
Lɑ sã n be yãab tɩ fo yã-b sẽn nɑ n wɑ yεεs-b tɩ põsgr me kɑ be, tɩ b be b yõgbẽ pẽem-pẽem.
Tɩ b nɑ n yeele: "tõnd kõo sɩd ne-ɑ". Lɑ b nɑ n mɑɑnɑ wãn n pɑam sɩd-kũun tɩ bãmb zĩig zãɑge?
La sɩd la hakɩɩka b kɩflame ne-a sẽn dɑ looge, la b pasd zĩri n yagd ne zɩɩlem, zĩig sẽn zãr ne sɩdẽ.
Tɩ b gɩd bãmb ne b sẽn datã, wɑlɑ b sẽn mɑɑn b wẽnes-n-tɑɑsã pĩndã, ad b yɩɩme n be sãmbg sẽn yood yɑm pʋgẽ.
